summary: The T049 contract lists `docs/spec/strategy/V4_POSITION_SIZING.md` as its first Deliverable, but `docs/spec/` is in the workflow controller's PROTECTED_PREFIXES (`tools/workflow/core.py` lines 80-87). The Developer role cannot write to any docs/spec/ path; only the PROPHET planning layer may add to docs/spec/ via a reviewed amendment. The Developer implemented the integer-only sizing module, pinned-vector tests, and Solidity-derived fixture at non-protected paths and reported TRIAGE_REQUIRED because the contract's stated deliverable path is unreachable from the contract's responsible role. The implementation itself is sound; the contract is internally inconsistent with the workflow rules and must be amended via the CONTRACT planning route. Reasoning: the contract specifies a deliverable at a path the responsible role cannot author. The Developer's implementation, tests, and pinned-vector fixtures are complete and pass all quality gates (pytest, ruff check, ruff format, mypy --strict) at non-protected paths. The contract's stated first Deliverable collides with PROTECTED_PREFIXES, so the task is unfinishable without an amendment. This is the textbook CONTRACT_MISMATCH case: amend T049 (CONTRACT layer) to either relocate the spec deliverable to a non-protected path inside docs/implement/ (Developer-authorable) or move the spec authoring out of the Developer task entirely (PROPHET/Planner-authorable), then have the controller rerun the same attempt against the amended contract. SPEC_DEFECT is rejected because the issue is with the task contract, not with the strategy Spec layer. OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED is rejected because no product question is open — the resolution path is mechanical: choose a developer-authorable path and amend the contract. IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT is rejected because the Developer correctly implemented everything reachable from the contract; the collision is in the contract itself, not in the implementation.
evidence: todo/phases/P05-features-and-valuation/T049.md, line 34 (Deliverables, first clause): `docs/spec/strategy/V4_POSITION_SIZING.md` — the path starts with `docs/spec/`, a protected prefix.

tools/workflow/core.py lines 80-87: PROTECTED_PREFIXES = ('.claude/', 'docs/intent/', 'docs/spec/', 'todo/phases/', 'todo/schemas/', 'tools/workflow/'). A Developer agent's finish-develop is rejected when any changed path starts with one of these prefixes (see line 418 `pathspecs = [*sorted(PROTECTED_FILES), *PROTECTED_PREFIXES]`).
tools/workflow/core.py line 507: `_PROPHET_EDITABLE_PREFIXES = ('docs/spec/', 'docs/intent/', 'docs/implement/')` confirms only the PROPHET layer may write to `docs/spec/`, not the Developer.
